---
title: Mixed take silver at the Northvale Classic
date: 2026-10-05
summary: Our own tournament came back bigger than ever, and the mixed squad fought all the way to the final.
cover: images/news/northvale-classic.svg
---

Twenty teams, two days of sunshine and one very muddy final. The **Northvale Classic** returned this
weekend, and our mixed squad went unbeaten through pool play before losing a tight final on universe point.

Captain Chloe Bennett said the squad was proud of the result:

> We had six first-years on the roster. Getting to the final with that many new faces is huge.

Thanks to every volunteer who helped run the fields, the scorers' tent and the barbecue.

![The mixed squad after the final](images/news/northvale-classic.svg)

## What's next

Indoor training starts on Tuesdays from next week. Beginners are always welcome — just turn up in trainers.
